project_title: Disease-associated gut microbiome and metabolome changes in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
project_description: Case-control study of faecal (stool) samples from 28 stable COPD patients and 29 healthy controls in Newcastle, Australia, profiled by 16S rRNA gene sequencing and shotgun metagenomics (MAG-based).
citation: Bowerman et al. 2020, Nature Communications, PMID 33208745
notes: Stable COPD (GOLD criteria), faecal samples. Direction from 16S sPLS-DA multivariate discriminant analysis listing genera increased/decreased in COPD; no per-taxon effect size or p-value stated in text, so none recorded. Controls not explicitly smoking-matched; covariate model elsewhere in the paper adjusted for age, sex and BMI only.

project_title: Gut microbiota was highly related to the immune status in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease patients
project_description: Case-control study of fecal samples from 40 stable COPD patients and 40 healthy controls at Guangfu Hospital, China, profiled by 16S rRNA gene sequencing with LEfSe.
citation: Wang et al. 2024, Aging (Albany NY), PMID 38349864
notes: Stable COPD (>4 weeks after exacerbation); GOLD grade I 5%, II 37.5%, III 52.5%, IV 5%. LEfSe threshold LDA > 3.0 and Wilcoxon P < 0.01; this genus was among the 5 taxa whose abundance was significantly increased in COPD, reported only as 'P < 0.001' (a bound, not an exact value), so p_value left blank. No per-taxon LDA score given. Smoking status of the healthy control group was not reported (Table 1 lists smoking history for COPD patients only). Findings not FDR-corrected as stated.

project_title: Characteristics of Gut Microbiota in Patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Based on Metagenomics and Metabolomics
project_description: Case-control study of fecal samples from 74 stable COPD patients and 30 healthy controls in northern China, profiled by shotgun metagenomic sequencing with LEfSe.
citation: Wang et al. 2026, International Journal of Molecular Sciences, PMID 42196196
notes: Stable COPD spanning GOLD grades I-IV (no significant diversity difference across grades, so groups were not stratified). LEfSe with LDA score threshold >= 3; no per-taxon LDA score or p-value stated in the text, so all effect-size columns left blank. Alpha diversity did not differ between groups; beta diversity separated groups (P = 0.018). Smoking status of controls not reported in the text.
